investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Flame Design
investigations.level_reason: Research Impacts/Earth Benefits names only higher efficiency and lower pollutant emissions in terrestrial combustors (e.g. coal power plants), with no fire-safety application.

investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator
investigations.level_reason: Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says BRE yielded data relevant to spacecraft fire safety: flames kept burning without air flow in the elevated-oxygen atmospheres considered for future spacecraft.

investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
investigations.level_reason: Objectives characterize extinction limits and sooting of weak coflow diffusion flames, and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says understanding flame extinction is critical in the suppression of fires.

investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
investigations.level_reason: Research Impacts/Earth Benefits states it is not being conducted to serve any space applications, but it is possible that its findings could aid the development of future space-based combustion devices; the benefits it names are cleaner, more efficient terrestrial combustion.

investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments-Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames
investigations.level_reason: Research Impacts/Earth Benefits names engine power, efficiency and emissions plus fundamental flame chemistry, with no fire-safety application.

investigations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says its primary goal is improved spacecraft fire safety, helping select the safest materials and improve firefighting methods.

investigations.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and its Objectives compare NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 with flammability in microgravity and test an inert gaseous extinguishing agent like the one used on ISS.

investigations.title: Cool Flames Investigation
investigations.level_reason: Objectives study droplet extinction and cool-flame behavior versus pressure and helium dilution; Research Impacts/Earth Benefits is mostly about engines and fuels but also cites safer spacecraft systems.

investigations.title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test / Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test-2
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and its Research Impacts/Earth Benefits test that the P-Trak smoke-particle counter used by SAME works in microgravity, for future fire and smoke detection systems.

investigations.title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
investigations.level_reason: Ground study whose Objectives derive temperature and soot fields from SPICE data to explain soot formation in 0 g versus 1 g; Research Impacts/Earth Benefits links it to safer fire detection and suppression.

investigations.title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and its Objectives aim to predict flammability limits of spacecraft materials by modeling concurrent flame spread benchmarked on BASS and BASS-II.

investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Objectives cover droplet extinction and flammability limits, though Research Impacts/Earth Benefits is about efficiency and emissions in transportation.

investigations.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Objectives map flammability limits of liquid fuels and measure the effectiveness of CO2, He and SF6 as fire suppressants in microgravity.

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I
investigations.level_reason: Objectives determine how fast a large-scale fire grows in low gravity and compare low-g flammability limits with NASA's normal-gravity material screening test.

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II
investigations.level_reason: Objectives determine how fast a large-scale fire grows in low gravity and compare low-g flammability limits with NASA's material screening test, even though its SubResearch Area says Surface Combustion.

investigations.title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-III
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Objectives determine large-scale fire growth and low-g flammability limits compared with NASA's normal-gravity material screening test.

investigations.title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety, its Objectives quantify smoke particle sizes in low gravity, and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says the results provide the reduced gravity baseline data against which future fire detection technology can be evaluated.

investigations.title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says SAME provides technology and sensitivity data for advanced fire detectors on future spacecraft.

investigations.title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
investigations.level_reason: Objectives study the structure, liftoff limits, soot and radiative heat loss of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity; Research Impacts/Earth Benefits mentions fire safety once, beside efficiency and emissions.

investigations.title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
investigations.level_reason: Objectives measure smoke points and sooting propensity of non-buoyant flames, and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits ties soot formation to designing safer spacecraft environments.

investigations.title: Utilization of the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment Data for Advanced Modeling and Simulation of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
investigations.level_reason: Ground study whose Objectives simulate how gravity changes pyrolysis smoke growth, and Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says it leads directly to better smoke detection devices.

investigations.title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
investigations.level_reason: Ground CFD study of FLEX droplet cool flames; Research Impacts/Earth Benefits says it could improve spacecraft fire-safety modeling, but its Objectives are about cool-flame dynamics.

investigations.title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation / Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
investigations.level_reason: SubResearch Area is Spacecraft Fire Safety and Objectives build a flammability-limit diagram for cool diffusion flames from FLEX data, though Research Impacts/Earth Benefits points to engines.

investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
investigations.level_reason: Research Impacts/Earth Benefits is about cool-flame kinetics for more efficient internal combustion engines.
